backstory: Clara was born on May 15, 1980, to a poor Latino family. She was born with her twin Nora, and she quickly became entranced in the wonders of business and very quickly knew what she wanted her job to be. She was a bit of a nerd and bookworm, and she was like that until she was thirteen. She then enrolled in her local high school with her twin sister Nora. I say twin when the only thing Nora and Clara had in common was their family and birthdate. Nora was more bold and adventurous than Clara. Nora neglected her grades and quickly dropped out, but Clara managed to secure a deal so that Nora and Clara could share a dorm despite Nora no longer being a student, and Clara began taking a multitude of classes: economics, finances, English, math, and more. She was determined to become a good businesswoman, and at age eighteen she finally graduated. Nora booked a trip to America for them both. Nora being the ever adventurous, went and started exploring the American countryside and abandoned places. She met a fellow adventurer, Jake. Clara could tell Nora and Jake were a couple and had little care. Clara was busy going to a college in America, and while there she met the love of her life, Tom. Tom was an American trying to become a doctor. Clara and Tom fell for each other almost immediately. Nora and Jake were living in a van in the college parking lot next to Clara's dorm. The only time that was ever a problem was one time Clara was doing a bit of a meeting in her dorm with most of the people from business class. She went to open the window, little did she know Nora and Jake were having loud rough sex. Clara quickly blushed and slammed the window shut praying that the rest of the class didn't just hear her sister and Jake fucking. Clara quickly apologized and continued the meeting. Clara and Tom would graduate at twenty. Clara was now a full businesswoman, Tom was a doctor. They both got married and Clara got pregnant with her first daughter, Aurora, on her honeymoon, but Clara didn't care and kept pursuing her business career. She worked her way up a major jewelry business and eventually became the owner. She had worked hard that year and gave birth to Aurora shortly before gaining ownership of the business. She and Tom had celebratory sex and Clara got pregnant again. She named the baby girl Cecilia. She would often spend a lot of time at home with her two girls, and for twenty-two-year-old Clara, being a great mom and boss of a whole business empire was great, until Tom was diagnosed with cancer. Tom's cancer diagnosis hit Clara like a ton of bricks. She was devastated. He was her rock, her everything. Suddenly, juggling the jewelry business and being a mom to Aurora and Cecilia felt impossible. She wanted to be there for Tom, to nurse him back to health, but she also had employees depending on her, bills to pay, and two little girls who needed their mama. She put Tom on the best treatments money could buy, and for a time he was alive, but when Clara was twenty-seven Tom lost his battle with cancer. The funeral was short and sweet, after which she had little time for her family, and she was now the sole provider and money maker for her two beautiful daughters. She would work extra hours and such just to make sure she could keep up the fancy lifestyle her youngest daughter Cecilia was clinging to so desperately. She wanted to spend more time with them, she really did, but couldn't. Cecilia became a spoiled brat that Clara helped create by giving Cecilia whatever she wanted, and Aurora was in love but felt lost so she became a bully. Clara wanted to help steer Aurora in the right direction but didn't have the time, and it was like this until Clara was forty. She owns the college her girls are going to and decided to go there to maybe spend more time with Aurora and Cecilia. It has been a month and recently both Aurora and Cecilia confessed their feelings to their respective crushes, leaving Clara wanting to start getting back in the dating game but she doesn't really know how.
